title: sre-oncall-scratchpad-2026-03-30
content:
SRE Oncall scratchpad - 2026-03-30
Owner: Maya Srinivasan (primary)
Shift: 08:00 - 20:00 PT
Collaborators: Noah Chen (secondary), Harper Wilson (handoff)

Summary of activity:
- 09:12 Pager: high-error-rate for /v1/generate on hosted-api (PD-INC-4321). Error spikes from 09:05-09:40.
  - Symptoms: 5xx rate jumped to ~18% for 2xx/5xx rolling window, latency p90 increased from 110ms -> 520ms.
  - Initial triage: confirmed with infra metrics (aws-alb 5xx count), service logs show upstream model container SIGBUS on two instances.
  - Mitigation: removed affected instances from LB, scaled up dedicated pool by +3 for hosted-api route, applied temporary routing policy to redirect 30% traffic to model-variant v2.1 which is stable.
  - Owner: me (Maya) for triage; Noah for scaling changes.
  - Linked notes: PD-INC-4321 timeline in PagerDuty, Slack thread (linked_artifacts).
  - Follow-ups: schedule root-cause analysis, add automated detection to alert when SIGBUS pattern occurs.

- 13:40 Alert: cache-evict-runner failing to complete jobs (JIRA-OPS-1234 created).
  - Symptoms: backlog of cache-evict tasks in SQS > 12k, worker task timeouts.
  - Triage: worker alpha fleet misconfiguration after last deploy: env var EVICT_TIMEOUT defaulted to 5s (should be 60s).
  - Mitigation: rollback to previous deployment on alpha, restart workers, processed backlog down to ~800 by 15:00.
  - Permanent fix: add sanity check in deployment pipeline to validate EVICT_TIMEOUT and add metric for avg job duration.
  - Owner: Harper to push pipeline check (due 2026-04-06).

Notes / Observations:
- Repeated SIGBUS in model containers correlates with sudden memory pressure on p4d nodes. Suspect quantized-kernel memory leak in runtime v0.9.2. Need to reproduce in staging with stress test.
- Traffic shift to model-variant v2.1 appears to preserve quality for affected customers; request QAE team for a quick sample-eval for top-5 customers routed.

Runbook TODOs (high priority):
- [ ] Update "model-container-sigbus" runbook with clearer steps for removing instances from LB and safe scaling sequence. (owner: Maya, due: 2026-04-02)
- [ ] Add automated pager rule for repeated SIGBUS pattern (3 SIGBUS within 10m across >=2 hosts). (owner: Noah, due: 2026-04-04)
- [ ] Add deployment pipeline check for critical env vars (EVICT_TIMEOUT, MAX_JOB_RETRIES). (owner: Harper, due: 2026-04-06)
- [ ] Create a staging stress test that runs quantized kernels on similar p4d configs to reproduce memory growth. (owner: Applied ML, contact: Priya Shah)

Action items completed during shift:
- Scaled up hosted-api dedicated pool +3 instances at 09:20 (no regressions after shift).
- Rolled back cache-evict alpha deploy at 14:05, restarted workers, validated backlog drain.
- Filed JIRA-OPS-1234 for pipeline check and linked in PD incident notes.

Pending/For next shift:
- Check PD-INC-4321 RCA draft from me; will start doc and assign reviewers (RCA due 2026-04-03).
- Monitor hosted-api p90 latency and 5xx rate for next 24h; set transient alert to 5% 5xx for >10m to catch regressions quickly.
- Follow up with QAE for sample evaluation of v2.1 quality impact (Slack pinged, awaiting reply).

Quick runbook edits to make after shift (notes to self):
- Add exact curl commands for safe draining of model containers and for verifying KV cache warm-up status.
- Add note on when to trigger automatic fallback to v1.9 vs manual routing to v2.1.
- Document owner rotation steps for dedicated pools (how to add burst capacity without violating SLA).

Misc checks / references executed:
- CloudWatch logs search for SIGBUS (query used) -> saved in linked artifacts.
- ALB metrics dashboard: error-rate & target-response-time.
- PagerDuty timeline exported and attached to JIRA-OPS-1234.

Handoff to next oncall (Harper Wilson) at 19:55 PT:
- Status: systems stable, hosted-api 5xx < 0.8%, p90 latency ~120ms.
- Open items: RCA draft, pipeline checks, verify backlog fully drained in 6h.
- Contact list: Noah Chen (infra), Priya Shah (Applied ML), QAE oncall (TBD).

Notes to self / personal TODO:
- Re-check reproducer in staging tomorrow morning (schedule 09:30).
- Draft RCA outline and drop into Confluence page "RCA-PD-4321".

End of scratchpad.
